_approach: Melodigging's description of krushclub as alternating between 'a halftime trap feel and Jersey Club bounce': here the kick sits on the halftime backbeat (1 and the 'and' of 3) like a trap beat rather than the 5-kick Jersey shape, the snare/clap lands on beat 3 (the halftime backbeat), and a clipped 808 glide (tomLow slot) slides under the kick. A trap-style hi-hat roll (triplet-feel burst approximated on the 16th grid) fires into beat 3 each bar — the clearest 'trap DNA inside krushclub' moment. Reference construction: Odetari / 6arelyhuman style halftime verses.
